title: Nasal septum surgery (septoplasty)
what: An ENT surgeon straightens the wall inside the nose, called the septum, so you can breathe more easily. The cuts are made inside the nose and cannot be seen from outside.
why: When a crooked septum makes it hard to breathe through your nose all the time, and nose drops do not help.
duration: surgery usually takes 30 to 90 minutes; the hospital stay is usually 1 to 3 days
tell_doctor: All your medicines, especially blood thinners and painkillers. The doctor will tell you what to stop and when
Heart or lung disease, or diabetes
If you or your relatives ever had problems with anesthesia

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: Blood tests, an ECG, and often a CT scan of the nose and sinuses. Your clinic will give you the list.

prepare.title: Anesthesiologist
prepare.text: The surgery is usually done under general anesthesia. Before it, an anesthesiologist will talk with you.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Usually no food from the evening before, and no drinks for a few hours before. Your clinic will give you the exact times.

prepare.title: Colds
prepare.text: If you have a runny nose or a fever the day before, tell your clinic. The surgery may be moved.

bring: Things for 1 to 3 days in hospital
steps: On the day of surgery, you change into a gown and an IV is put into a vein
In the operating room, the anesthesiologist gives the anesthetic, and you fall asleep
The surgeon works through the nostrils, with no cuts on the face
Bent parts of cartilage and bone are straightened or removed
Soft packs or thin splints are placed in the nose
You wake up in the recovery room
feel: Your nose is blocked, so you breathe through your mouth while the packs are in
Pressing pain and heaviness in the nose. You will get pain relief
A little bloody discharge in the first days
after: Packs are usually removed after 1 to 2 days, and splints later. It is unpleasant but quick
Do not blow your nose hard. Sneeze with your mouth open
For 2 weeks, no sauna, hot baths, sport, or heavy lifting
Rinse your nose as the doctor says
Breathing usually becomes easier after a few weeks, when the swelling goes down
red_flags: A nosebleed that does not stop: call emergency services
Strong pain or pain that keeps getting worse, or a swollen face
Clear, watery fluid dripping from the nose

faq.q: Will my nose look different after septoplasty?
faq.a: Usually not. The surgery is inside the nose, so its shape does not change, unless it is combined with a nose job.

faq.q: Does it hurt to remove the nose packs?
faq.a: It is unpleasant for a few seconds. Today soft packs with breathing tubes are often used.

reminders.text: Surgery tomorrow. Pack your things, ID, and medicine list. Eat and drink only until the times your clinic gave you.
